To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) mortality from injuries was substantially higher among Brazilian steel workers than in the general population of the state of Sao Paulo; 2) mortality from motor vehicle injury among steel workers was more than twice that in the general male population; and 3) mortality from occupational injury decreased during the period of the study, possibly due to improvements in safety, medical care, and automation.
